title: Repeat-Error Multiple on the Design Studio Selections Goodwill Credit Cap
content:
On a Design Studio Selections file, the goodwill credit cap from which the file's goodwill room starts — as that cap stands after any raise it carries — is multiplied by a repeat-error multiple before the builder goodwill credit already granted on the file is subtracted. The multiple is set by the number of error-correcting change orders on the file:

| Error-correcting change orders on the file | Repeat-error multiple |
|---|---|
| Three or more | 3 |
| Exactly two | 2 |
| A single one | 1 |

**Records read.** The change order entries on the file's design ledger written to correct a studio or builder error, counted over the whole file, the change order being compensated included.

**Hypothetical figures** (cap 500.00 before the multiple; builder goodwill already granted 300.00)

| Error-correcting change orders | Cap after the multiple | Goodwill room |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 500.00 | 200.00 |
| 2 | 1000.00 | 700.00 |
| 4 | 1500.00 | 1200.00 |

The credit already granted is subtracted from the multiplied cap, never from the cap before multiplication.
